name: Whitebox Entry Fan-out
description: Whitebox pass: discover request-handler entry points, fan out one security-auditor child per entry (max 20), parent-review candidates, then independently validate survivors and gate the report. Source only. No live target unless RoE is already in the child prompt.

steps.name: Discover entries
steps.description: List request-handler files under the repo root via security_intel ci_scan / EntryFanout.plan. Reuse CiScan.discover_entries. Fail closed if the root is missing. No live network.
steps.acceptance_criteria: Entry list produced (relative paths). Root missing is an error, not an empty clean scan.

steps.name: Fan out one auditor per entry
steps.description: Call EntryFanout.plan then delegate one security-auditor child per entry, max 20. Each child is bounded to that file and symbols it calls. Basics first: IDOR/authz, then injection. Children return candidates, not confirmed findings.
steps.acceptance_criteria: At most 20 children spawned. Each prompt names one entry. Each child returns candidates with class, file:line, confidence 0-10 (non-remote cap 6).

steps.name: Parent review + independent validation
steps.description: Parent reads candidate lists. Drop self-confirmed noise. Spawn security_validation per surviving finding. Empty queue for a class is not assessed, not clean. Do not invent RoE. No live target unless RoE is already in the prompt.
steps.acceptance_criteria: Surviving findings each have an independent validation child. Rejected candidates recorded. Classes with empty queues marked not assessed.

steps.name: Report gate + evidence
steps.description: Run report_gate on validated findings. Require CVSS, CWE, and a receipt (poc / evidence_path / evidence_id). Attach evidence. Produce SARIF. Rank by severity. No payload generation.
steps.acceptance_criteria: Eligible findings scored with CVSS + CWE + evidence receipt. Ineligible findings dropped or marked needs-evidence. SARIF written.
